obligations.expected_outcome: The first image response leaves the structured interpretation empty, waits at description confirmation, and cannot admit a draft.
Blank, unknown and incomplete answers cannot advance the session; all platform-issued question ids with nonblank answers are required before interpretation confirmation queues a model step.
A draft result is rejected for an unconfirmed description, unconfirmed interpretation, incomplete answer set, changed image or changed interpretation.
A replacement image clears description, interpretation, every answer, confirmation and draft before its transient read starts.
The public route rejects stale or malformed answer commands and exact replay returns the recorded snapshot without applying the answer twice.
Only the existing injected LLM port carries the two phase fields; no new context import or provider-owned session state is introduced.
